headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong top‑line gains while others saw modest or slowing expansion.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech and Tech Mahindra delivered double‑digit growth, supported by AI‑related wins. Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% revenue growth, the weakest among the peers. Profit trends were mixed, with HCLTech posting a 21% jump while Wipro and Infosys saw profit pressure.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth, HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m, and LTM seeing a 47% AI surge.

themes.title: Margin guidance shifts
themes.detail: Coforge raised its FY27 EBIT margin to 16%, while Infosys cut its revenue growth guidance to 1‑2%. HCLTech kept an operating margin of 18.2% despite higher growth.

themes.title: Headcount and attrition pressure
themes.detail: HCLTech added 6,450 staff but attrition stayed near 13%, and Wipro reported a net headcount decline of 6,716, indicating talent challenges.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and upgraded EBIT margin guidance.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
